name: George Francis Adams (#1)

Served in the Confederate army during the Civil War under Generals Price, Van Dorn, and McGruder

milestones: Settled in Chariton County MO abt 1836
Moved to Douglas County CO in 1878
Served as Justice of the Peace in Missouri
Developed a section of land for a stock business
Retired to Castle Rock, Colorado, in 1886
Married Cynthia Lane (14 January 1841, Chariton County, MO)
Buried: Cedar Hills Cemetery, Castle Rock, CO — unmarked grave in Adams Family Plot
Census trail: Chariton County MO (1850, 1860, 1870) → Douglas County CO (1880)
notes: Siblings listed: Alexander Washington, Magdalena (Margaret), Mary (twin), Harriet Josephine, Susan (twin), and Ursula (twin)
